surfaces.note: Update the source, republish to the SAME url, then run scripts/ci/artifact-currency.mjs --sync era-review. Bumping the sha without republishing makes the check lie.

Not published to a URL, so there is no sha to record — drift is measured from this file's OWN last commit, which git knows and nobody can mistype. The kernel calls keeping it current a session-close obligation; it had gone 17 commits stale with no gate while STATUS and CHANGELOG stayed immaculate. Regenerate and commit it.
